inputs.name: mysql_version
inputs.description: MySQL long-term support series to install from MySQL's repository: "9.7" or "8.4". Changing it on a host that already runs MySQL switches the repository but doesn't upgrade the server.

inputs.name: bind_address
inputs.description: Addresses MySQL listens on, comma-separated, such as "127.0.0.1", "0.0.0.0" or "127.0.0.1,10.0.0.5". Changing it restarts MySQL.

inputs.name: settings
inputs.description: Server settings for the [mysqld] section, such as { max_connections = "200", innodb_buffer_pool_size = "1G" }. They go to a zz-conn3x.cnf drop-in, and changing them restarts MySQL.

inputs.name: users
inputs.description: Accounts to create, one per entry in user_hosts. Each needs a password in user_passwords.

inputs.name: user_passwords
inputs.description: Password for each of users, by name. Pass it at run time with -var or TF_VAR_user_passwords; it never reaches state or the plan.

inputs.name: user_hosts
inputs.description: Hosts each of users may connect from, such as "localhost", "10.0.0.%" or "10.0.0.0/255.255.255.0". Every user gets one account per entry, with the same password and grants.

inputs.name: grants
inputs.description: Privileges each of users gets on a database, such as { user = "app", database = "app" } for all of them, or privileges = ["SELECT"]. They apply to every one of the user's accounts.
